title: Malicious code in t4-xorspawn-testmetest (npm)
description: The npm package t4-xorspawn-testmetest version 1.0.0 contains obfuscated code that reconstructs the 'child_process' module name via XOR decoding, attempts to locate a Bun runtime, writes a JavaScript file to the OS temporary directory, and spawns the Bun runtime to execute that file. Although the written file is currently empty and no payload executes, the code structure matches known patterns for malicious alternate-runtime droppers in npm packages.
